notes: Covers service.professional.other (and any subcode without its own rule). The exclusion reaches professional services except those listed in § 47-2001(n)(1): data processing and information services (IT and accounting have their own rules), real property maintenance, landscaping, security and private investigation services, and the others listed there; a .other service that is one of those is taxable. citations.title: D.C. Code § 47-2002, Imposition of tax
citations.quote: A tax is imposed upon all vendors for the privilege of selling at retail certain tangible personal property

notes: The District is a single taxing jurisdiction with no separate local sales tax; this rule exists because the schema requires a DC:local rule beside a special-rate DC rule, and no local part is ever charged. No official page stating that in those words was archived.

summary: No local sales tax applies to this code in the District of Columbia.
